title: ctenopteris maidenii
intro: Ctenopteris maidenii, commonly known as the Maiden's Hair Fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant is rich in health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve respiratory issues, and lower blood pressure due to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Ctenopteris maidenii are primarily attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which exhibit anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antiviral activities. Additionally, Ctenopteris maidenii has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various ailments, including fever, cough, and digestive issues.
